questions.question: Gateway 是否只是接受了唯一 tool-call shape？
questions.answer: 是，但这只是第一层。Gateway 证据为 accept_unique_expected；它本身不证明下游 Contract/Domain closure。

questions.question: tool arguments 是否成功提取？
questions.answer: 是。一个 native object 被提取，arguments_present=true，未保存原文。

questions.question: JSON/parser 是否通过？
questions.answer: 通过。Provider 与 normalized observation 均记录 argument_json_parse_status=native_object。

questions.question: Schema 是否通过？
questions.answer: 通过到足以形成 valid Contract Runtime receipt；但没有独立、逐 validator 的 schema receipt，因此证据粒度为 supported_not_independently_signed。

questions.question: Contract Adapter 是否通过？
questions.answer: 通过。Adapter projection 为 exact，exact expected-tool matches=1，validator_set 包含 contract_adapter。

questions.question: Domain Validator 是否通过？
questions.answer: 通过。Recovery attempt outcome=valid，exact_v2 binding 的 validator_set 包含 domain_validator。

questions.question: Planning Adaptation invariants 是否通过？
questions.answer: 通过。后续 Planning Adaptation merge 明确进入 ready，equivalent=2、protocol_repairs=6、semantic_repairs=0。

questions.question: Whole receipt 是否正式成为 accepted artifact？
questions.answer: 是。exact_v2 resume binding 记录 artifact、input/output hash、policy/version 与 validator set；输出文件和 receipt 均存在于隔离 run。

questions.question: 是否写入合法 checkpoint？
questions.answer: 无法证明。存在 last checkpoint identity，但 checkpoint 与该 exact artifact 的 execution binding 为 unverifiable。

questions.question: 是否成为后续阶段的输入？
questions.answer: 业务路径上是：merge ready 后调用 11 进入 causal-chain；但 call 11 没有保存 exact predecessor object binding，因此 object-hash 级直接边保持 unknown。
questions.evidence: call 11 stage=planning-causal-chain; exact predecessor binding absent

questions.question: 是否被后续 retry/fallback 丢弃或失效？
questions.answer: 没有证据表明被丢弃或 supersede。Call 11～14 是下游 causal-chain 恢复，不是 Whole receipt 重试。
questions.evidence: whole binding superseded_artifact=null; subsequent stage changed to planning

questions.question: Planning Adaptation boundary 是否真正闭合？
questions.answer: Contract/Domain/Planning Adaptation 业务边界已闭合；整个 Short workflow 未闭合。Canary 目标也已闭合，但旧 runner 未在闭合后阻断下一 Provider dispatch。
questions.evidence: call 10 valid accepted artifact; call 11 normal downstream; terminal after call 22

conclusion: Gateway acceptance was necessary but not sufficient. Independent downstream evidence confirms the Whole receipt became a valid accepted artifact and closed the Planning Adaptation boundary. The terminal occurred later, after call 22, in Draft prose validation.
